message: `.ic V({name})=...`: the deck has no net `{name}`
description: A `.ic` initial condition names a net that does not exist in the circuit. It is an error rather than skipped, because the run would otherwise start from a state other than the one the deck asks for.
actions: Check the net name. A net inside a subcircuit instance is named `<instance>.<net>`, for example `X1.mid`.
